# Charters Union — Full LLM Context

## About Charters Union

Charters Union (A unit of Shanti Informatics) is a Kolkata-based, AI-first job-ready training institute. We offer career-focused business education with paid internships and global placement support.

**Core Promise:** From Fresher to Global Career — AI in Every Class, Faculty-Guided Paid Internships, Job-Ready Training Built for Top MNCs.

**Placement Stats:** 92% placement rate, ₹3.5 LPA average starting salary, 7-month programs, 4–6 month paid internships across 7 countries. Top performers reach ₹7.3 LPA.

---

## Programmes

### Certified Business Accountant
A comprehensive accounting certification program aligned with AICPA and ACCA standards. Covers practical accounting, taxation, auditing, financial reporting, and ERP systems. Includes a paid internship and placement support.

### Digital Growth & Marketing
A digital marketing program covering SEO, SEM, social media marketing, content marketing, email marketing, analytics, and growth hacking. Aligned with Google and HubSpot certifications.

### Technology & Business Management
An interdisciplinary program bridging technology and management. Covers business analytics, IT project management, ERP, digital transformation, and emerging technologies. Aligned with Harvard Business School Online frameworks.

- **Careers / Jobs** (`/careers/jobs`) — Active job listings

- **Faculties** (`/faculties`) — Faculty profiles, visiting professors, industry mentors
- **Blogs** (`/blogs`) — Educational content, industry insights, career advice
- **Privacy Policy** (`/privacy-policy`)
- **Terms and Conditions** (`/terms-and-conditions`)

## Core Features

- AI-powered career path assessment
- Hands-on learning with real business use cases
- 7 student-run businesses for practical experience
- Corporate English and soft skills training
- AI interview coaching with mock interviews
- LinkedIn personal branding program
- 4–6 month paid internships in 7 countries
- Direct placement support with 200+ partner companies
